credits.title: What Remains
credits.overview: A poet breaks free from a life that has become suffocating to reconnect with her inner voice and conscience and allow her creativity to flow again. credits.title: Araf/Somewhere in Between
credits.overview: Araf is the story of Zehra and Olgun whose lives are caught in a vacuum. The world in which they live and work is a place of throwaway culture and constant change. They too are waiting for a chance to change and escape from their empty, monotonous lives.

credits.title: Waiting for the Clouds
credits.overview: A member of a Greek family in Turkey is forced to immigrate from Trabzon to Mersin in her youth. However, events cause her to face her own past.
